import copy,json,multiprocessing as mp,time,sys,unittest
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'.agents/skills/implement-change-harness/scripts')
from harness_state import Harness,Invalid,git,REF
from harness_parallel import index_of
from test_harness_migration import LiveFixture
class Fixture(LiveFixture,unittest.TestCase):pass

def start(source,root,run,payload,authority,barrier,out):
 try:
  h=Harness(source,root_issue=root,run_id=run,fixture_authority=authority)
  p=copy.deepcopy(payload);p.update(root_issue=root,run_id=run);p.pop('original',None)
  p['repository'].update(implementation_worktree=source,branch='codex/'+run)
  barrier.wait(15)
  result=h.apply('initialize',p,None,0)
  until=time.monotonic()+90
  while result.get('artifact_publication',{}).get('status')!='confirmed':
   assert time.monotonic()<until,result
   rows=h.store.records(h.store.tip());s=h.selected(rows)
   result=h.apply('publish-artifacts',{},h.store.tip(),s['revision'] if s else 0)
  rows=h.store.records(h.store.tip());s=h.selected(rows)
  out.put({'root':root,'run':run,'state':s is not None,'observer':index_of(rows)['waiting'].get(h.selector()),'tip':h.store.tip()})
 except BaseException as error:
  import traceback
  out.put({'error':repr(error),'trace':traceback.format_exc()})

def probe(child):
 f=Fixture(methodName='runTest');f.setup_live()
 try:
  other=f.create('Child',f.original[0]['requirement']) if child else f.root_issue
  if child:f.gh.api('issues/'+str(f.root_issue['number'])+'/sub_issues','POST',{'sub_issue_id':other['id']})
  sources=[]
  for run in ('race-A','race-B'):
   source=f.root/run;git(f.repo,'clone',str(f.bare),str(source));git(source,'checkout','-b','codex/'+run,'origin/master')
   git(source,'config','user.name','Race');git(source,'config','user.email','race@example.invalid');sources.append(str(source))
  ctx=mp.get_context('fork');barrier=ctx.Barrier(2);out=ctx.Queue()
  workers=[ctx.Process(target=start,args=(source,issue['html_url'],run,f.payload,str(f.resource_authority),barrier,out)) for source,issue,run in zip(sources,(f.root_issue,other),('race-A','race-B'))]
  for w in workers:w.start()
  for w in workers:
   w.join(110)
   if w.is_alive():w.kill();w.join(5);raise AssertionError('race watchdog')
   assert w.exitcode==0,w.exitcode
  results=[out.get(timeout=5)for _ in workers];assert not any('error'in r for r in results),results
  reader=Harness(sources[0],root_issue=f.root_issue['html_url'],run_id='race-A',fixture_authority=f.resource_authority)
  remote=git(sources[0],'ls-remote','--refs','origin',REF).decode().split()[0]
  git(sources[0],'fetch','--no-write-fetch-head','origin',REF+':refs/harness/race-observed')
  rows=reader.store.records(remote);idx=index_of(rows)
  assert len(idx['runs'])==1,idx

  assert len({owner['owner']for owner in idx['claims'].values()})==1,idx
  assert not f.service().get('pr_create_count'),f.service()
  return {'scenario':'root-child'if child else'same-issue','results':results,'owners':list(idx['runs']),'observers':list(idx['waiting']),'claimed':sorted(idx['claims']),'no_PR_created':True}
 finally:f.doCleanups()
results=[probe(False),probe(True)]
